stories.title: Kanwar route sees meat and liquor shop closure:Helicopters and drones monitor movement; DGP warns against spreading rumours
stories.summary: Senior officials from Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Delhi, Uttarakhand and Rajasthan held a meeting in Meerut on Monday to review security arrangements for the Kanwar Yatra, which will be held from July 30 to August 11. The states discussed their preparations for the Kanwar route and coordination for the annual pilgrimage. UP DGP Rajiv Krishna said meat and liquor shops will remain closed along the Kanwar route, which will be monitored through helicopters, drones and CCTV cameras. Heavy vehicles will be barred from city routes, while Kanwariyas and other traffic will use separate lanes. Border security will also be strengthened with dog squads, bomb disposal teams, intelligence units and local police. During the meeting, UP Chief Secretary SP Goyal directed officials to ensure proper cleanliness, lighting, drainage and standard facilities at Kanwar camps. DJ height will not be more than 12 feet DGP Rajiv Krishna said - The sound of the DJ will not be more than 75 decibels. The height of the DJ will not be more than 12 feet. DJ operators have been asked not to hold DJ competitions. The in-charges of those groups have also been asked to ensure that there is no race in Dak Kanwar. The arrangements for food and drink on the Kanwar route should be proper. The Irrigation Department should monitor the water level in the canal. PWD should repair the roads. The department should also review the incidents that have occurred due to various reasons. Incidents caused by the negligence of the Electricity Department should not happen now. Pure vegetarian food should be served at dhabas and hotels. From where the Kanwar procession starts, the height of the Kanwar and the standards for songs played on DJ should be taken care of. If the Kanwar breaks on the way, provide Ganga water to the devotee UP Chief Secretary SP Goyal said- If for any reason the Kanwar breaks on the way, Ganga water should be made available immediately. Teams should already arrange for Ganga water. Water will be ordered from Haridwar and kept. The quality of food will be checked at the Kanwar Seva camps. He said- Robust arrangements for security, crowd management, sanitation, and medical facilities should be made at Kanwar lifting points, bathing ghats, major temples, and Jalabhishek sites. Medical camps, bike ambulances, and a sufficient number of beds should be reserved in hospitals on all major routes as per requirement, so that devotees can receive immediate treatment in any emergency. Monitoring will be done with helicopters, drones, CCTV DGP Rajiv Krishna informed about the security arrangements for the Kanwar route. He said - the security of the Kanwar route will be ensured by helicopters, drones, and CCTVs. Separate toilet and bathing facilities will be provided for male and female Kanwariyas. Barricading will be increased for the security of the ghats. Meat and liquor shops will be closed on the Kanwar route. Heavy vehicles will be prohibited on the Kanwar route. Kanwar camps will be set up 20 feet inside the road on the left side. All electricity poles on the Kanwar route are being covered with polythene and transformers with mesh. If there is any major event or examination in any district, its information will have to be given to the government. DGP said - will deal strictly with those spreading rumors After the meeting, the DGP also inaugurated the Integrated Command and Control Center built in the Police Line. In the press conference, he said - Every year new challenges arise during the Kanwar Yatra, and this time too there are some special challenges. Regarding this, officers have been instructed to find solutions to all potential problems in time, so that law and order and traffic management are not affected. A sufficient number of police and administrative personnel will be deployed at the entry and exit points of national highways, state highways, and expressways, so that devotees are not confused and can be safely directed to the designated routes. Those spreading rumors and misleading information will be dealt with strictly. Performed Jalabhishek at Augharnath Temple Chief Secretary SP Goyal and DGP Rajiv Krishna also performed Jalabhishek after reaching Baba Augharnath Temple. On this occasion, ADG Meerut Zone Bhanu Bhaskar, Divisional Commissioner Bhanu Chand Goswami, DIG Range Kalanidhi Naithani, DM Dr. VK Singh, along with police and administrative officers, were present.

stories.title: UP plans 330km Vindhya Expressway:Six-hour travel cut to three hours; 12 proposals likely to get cabinet nod today
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet is likely to approve the alignment of two new expressways at a meeting chaired by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday. The proposed projects include the 330-km Vindhya Expressway from Prayagraj to Sonbhadra and the 117-km Vindhya-Purvanchal Link Expressway connecting the Vindhya and Purvanchal expressways. Chief Secretary SP Goyal released the agenda for the cabinet meeting on Monday evening. Around 12 proposals will be discussed during the meeting at the Chief Minister's residence today. Sources said the proposal to convene the monsoon session is not part of the agenda but may still come up for discussion, with the government considering holding the session in the last week of July or from August 3. Connectivity of UP with 5 states will increase An UPD official said- The Vindhya Expressway will start from the last end of the Ganga Expressway (Sonwar Tehsil) in Prayagraj. After this, it will go through Mirzapur, Bhadohi, Varanasi, and Chandauli to Sonbhadra. This will directly connect UP with the borders of Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Jharkhand, promoting inter-state trade. The estimated cost of the project is 22,400 crore rupees. After the construction of the expressway, the journey from Prayagraj to Sonbhadra will be completed in three and a quarter hours, which currently takes up to six and a half hours. The Vindhya-Purvanchal Link Expressway will connect the last end of the Purvanchal Expressway in Chandauli-Ghazipur to the Vindhya Expressway. After the construction of this 130 km long expressway, the Purvanchal Expressway, Vindhya Expressway, and Ganga Expressway will be interconnected, providing seamless connectivity from Delhi directly to the borders of Bihar and Madhya Pradesh. stories.title: Gunfire breaks out after BJYM state chief departs Meerut:Welcome party comes under attack; victim claims car ramming attempt
stories.summary: Shots were fired in Meerut on Monday shortly after BJP Yuva Morcha state president Rohit Mishra's convoy left Partapur Toll Plaza, where around 400 party workers had gathered to welcome him. Police said the firing was linked to an old rivalry between two groups that had come to attend the same event. According to police, one group allegedly arrived with weapons. The complainant, Shwetank Tyagi, alleged that the attackers first tried to run him over with a car before opening fire. The incident took place around 1 pm, and a case has been registered at Partapur police station. See 3 pictures Rivalry ongoing since college days Shwetank Tyagi, a resident of Jagriti Vihar, said- I had gone to attend the welcome program of BJYM State President Rohit Mishra with my friend Manish Thakur. Rahul Adhana, Praveen Sharma, and Avnish, residents of Ganganagar, also came there. A dispute has been ongoing between Manish Thakur and Rahul Adhana since their college days. Shwetank alleges that Rahul and his companions came to the program carrying weapons. As soon as Rohit Mishra's procession moved past the toll plaza, Rahul Adhana, Praveen Sharma, and Avnish tried to run us over with their vehicles. We somehow managed to escape. After this, Rahul Adhana and Praveen Sharma got out of the car. They took out pistols and started firing. But, their aim missed, and we narrowly escaped. Chief Secretary and DGP were in Meerut At the time of the incident, UP Chief Secretary SP Goyal and DGP Rajiv Krishna were also present in Meerut. About 1 hour before the firing, both officials had reached the Commissioner's Office via the Partapur police station area. Both officers had come there to hold a high-level meeting regarding the Kanwar Yatra. SP City Vinayak Gopal Bhosle said Four police teams have been deployed to investigate the matter. The accused are being identified based on CCTV footage and videos from the scene. A case has been registered and action is being taken based on the complaint of the victim's side. Now see 3 pictures of Rohit Mishra's welcome Around 400 workers had arrived to welcome Rohit Mishra at the toll plaza. Rohit Mishra was welcomed by workers for 4 km BJYM State President Dr. Rohit Mishra reached Kashi Toll Plaza on Monday afternoon around 12 PM. Here, workers already present welcomed him by garlanding him with flowers. Around 500 vehicles were part of his convoy. Workers welcomed him at various places for about 4 km from the toll plaza. During this, a worker garlanded him with a bulldozer. On this occasion, Dr. Rohit Mishra said, "Youth are the future of the country. Youth have the most important role in nation-building, strengthening the organisation, and fulfilling the resolve of a developed India. "He called upon young workers to take the organisation's ideology to the masses, actively participate in social service work, and strengthen the organisation by prioritising national interest.

stories.title: Love triangle erupts in hotel lobby:Wife catches husband with girlfriend; beats him for 10 minutes
stories.summary: A woman in Uttar Pradesh's Chandauli allegedly caught her husband with his girlfriend at a hotel and dragged them onto the street, where she assaulted the woman. When her husband tried to stop her, she accused him of abandoning his family and said she had been following him for several days before catching him. The woman allegedly beat her husband's girlfriend for nearly 10 minutes as a crowd gathered but did not intervene. Police later took all three to the police station, where the dispute continued for about two hours. The incident took place at a hotel in the Mughalsarai police station area on Sunday evening, and videos of the incident surfaced on Monday afternoon. First, 2 pictures... Reached the hotel while chasing the husband Prem Chauhan (45), a resident of Alinagar, is a truck driver by profession. Besides his wife, he has 2 children in the family. The elder son is 18 years old, while the daughter is 16 years old. Prem had been having an affair with a woman from the same village for about a year. It is said that the woman runs a hotel at Aloo Mill Chowk. She is married. On Sunday evening around 6 PM, Prem left home making an excuse to his wife. After this, he reached a hotel in the Khoya Mandi area with his girlfriend. When his wife became suspicious, she also followed him to the hotel. Seeing her husband with another woman in the hotel room, she started creating a scene. She took both of them out of the room and brought the girlfriend out into the street, holding her. The woman started saying that she already suspected her husband was having an affair elsewhere. Today, after following him, everything was exposed. I will make a video of them and make it viral. He is lying to us and trying to promote this. Wife's Mangalsutra Broke During Scuffle After this, the wife starts beating the girlfriend by grabbing her hair. Meanwhile, the husband tells the girlfriend, "Don't worry, I will deal with her." At this, the wife gets even more enraged. She pushes her away. During the fight, the girlfriend grabbed her mangalsutra. At this, the wife threatened, saying, "Let go of the mangalsutra, or I will set you on fire." However, the mangalsutra broke during the scuffle. People Present at the Scene Made a Video During the fight between the husband, wife, and girlfriend, there was a chaotic atmosphere outside the hotel for some time. Many people present there made videos of this fight. Meanwhile, someone informed the police. The police took all three to the Mughalsarai Kotwali. There, both their family members were called and counselled. Station Officer Vijay Pratap Singh said - The husband was caught by his wife with another woman. All three were creating a ruckus. They have been counselled and warned. After this, no one filed a written complaint.

stories.title: Police block AAP-led Sonam Wangchuk rally:Protesters stopped at Shastri Ghat; ACM later clears march ahead
stories.summary: AAP workers and members of several social organisations staged a protest in Varanasi on Monday in support of Sonam Wangchuk and the CJP march from Jantar Mantar to Parliament in New Delhi. The protesters had planned a foot march from Shastri Ghat to the district headquarters, but police stopped them at Shastri Ghat and said they could hold a sit-in there instead. After discussions, ACM First reached the spot and asked the protesters to submit their memorandum. The protesters requested permission to march to Ambedkar Park, and after talks with the police, the peaceful march was allowed under police presence. The memorandum was later submitted to the ACM at Ambedkar Park. See 2 pictures "This is not a party, it is a movement of common people" Aam Aadmi Party District President Kailash Patel said, "This is not a program of any party, but a program for common people. Many parties and people from society are involved in it. The way irregularities have occurred in the NEET exam is wrong. Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan should resign." He said, "We have gathered here in support of Sonam Wangchuk's protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi. This is a question of our children's future. All organizations have been invited, and whoever comes here is welcome." Police stopped with barricading Currently, the police have stopped the protesters at Shastri Ghat by putting up ropes and barricades. They have not been allowed to proceed further. The administration has called the ACM to the spot so that the protesters can hand over their memorandum to him. During this time, people present at the protest site are expressing their protest by singing revolutionary songs. Permission Granted After Discussion with ACM First The protesters told the ACM First who arrived at the spot that they had to go to the district headquarters, but now they should only be allowed to go to Baba Saheb's statue located in Ambedkar Park. "We will not raise any slogans. Nor will we break any kind of law and order." Upon this, the ACM, after talking to the police, granted them permission and personally accompanied the protesters to the park, where he received the memorandum and assured them that it would be delivered to the concerned authorities.

stories.title: AAP stages protest backing Sonam Wangchuk:Memorandum handed to Gorakhpur DM; paper leak and unemployment questioned
stories.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) on Monday staged a protest outside the District Magistrate's office in Gorakhpur in support of Sonam Wangchuk, who is on a hunger strike at Jantar Mantar. Party workers submitted a memorandum to the President through the District Magistrate, raising concerns over paper leaks, unemployment and transparency in government recruitment. In the memorandum, AAP said repeated paper leaks are hurting the hard work and future of millions of young people. The party demanded a fair and timely investigation into all such cases, strict action against those responsible, stronger laws to prevent paper leaks, and a transparent recruitment process. 'Youth's Voice Being Suppressed' District President Vijay Kumar Srivastava said that Sonam Wangchuk's movement is connected to the future and rights of the youth. He alleged that instead of solving problems, the government is taking action against those who raise their voices. He said that peaceful protest is a democratic right and attempts to suppress it are not appropriate. Demand for employment policy District in-charge Praveen Kumar Yadav said that youth are most affected by unemployment and irregularities in recruitment processes. He demanded that the government provide permanent employment opportunities and solve the problems of the youth on a priority basis. He also warned that if the demands are not met, the movement will be further expanded. Memorandum sent to the President The party urged the President to improve the education system, conduct an impartial investigation into paper leak cases, take strict action against the culprits, formulate a concrete employment policy for the youth, and ensure the protection of the constitutional right to peaceful protest. District President Vijay Kumar Srivastava and District In-charge Praveen Kumar Yadav, along with a large number of workers, were present at the protest.

stories.title: Man injured in Gorakhpur knife attack dies:Family in shock as police book unknown assailant
stories.summary: In the Harpur Budhat police station area of Gorakhpur, a young man injured in a stabbing incident died at BRD Medical College on Monday morning at 6 am after 24 hours of treatment. The deceased got married four years ago. He did not have children. After the family received the news of the death, there was wailing and crying at home. Based on the father's complaint, police registered a case of attempted murder against unknown persons on Sunday. The murder charge will now be added to it. Police are also examining CCTV cameras installed around the crime scene to identify the accused. Premsagar Yadav (30), a resident of Tola Jungle Digar Supa in Baidauli village of Harpur Budhat, had left home on Saturday evening around 6 pm saying he was going to the market on his motorcycle. When he did not return home late at night, the family searched for him, but no information was found. Died during treatment on Monday morning On Sunday morning around 7 am, villagers found a young man lying unconscious in a pool of blood on the roadside near the Baijalpura Gram Panchayat building. Harpur-Budhat police, who arrived on information, identified the injured as Premsagar Yadav. He was first sent by ambulance to CHC Sahjanwa, then to the district hospital, and due to his critical condition, to Nehru Hospital of BRD Medical College. He died on Monday morning during treatment there. Premsagar had been attacked on the head with a sharp weapon. Father Gyanendra said that Premsagar was married in 2022 to Neha Yadav, a resident of Usrapar village in Mahuli police station area of Sant Kabir Nagar district. The couple has no children. In the family, Premsagar's elderly grandmother, elder brother, and his wife live. Premsagar's wife had gone to her maternal home (Usrapar, Thana Mahuli, Sant Kabir Nagar) six months ago. It is being said that there was discord between the two. After the incident, the family members are in a terrible state, crying inconsolably. Premsagar used to help his brother with farm work. SP North Gyanendra Kumar said that based on the father's complaint, Harpur-Budhat police have registered a case against unknown persons. Information about the accused is being gathered based on surveillance and other technical evidence.

stories.title: Tripura DGP found dead in office, suicide suspected:1994-batch IPS officer from UP had probed the 1984 anti-Sikh riots
stories.summary: The body of Tripura DGP Anurag Dhankar, a resident of UP, has been found. On Monday morning, he was found unconscious at the police headquarters. Officials rushed him to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. According to the police's preliminary investigation, Anurag Dhankar committed suicide. His body has been kept at Govind Ballabh Pant Hospital in Agartala for now. Police and forensic teams are investigating at the scene. Anurag Dhankar was a 1994-batch IPS officer and a resident of Baghpat. He had investigated the 1984 anti-Sikh riots. Anurag Dhankar came to Baghpat 25 years ago Anurag Dhankar was a resident of Biharipur village, about 7 kilometers away from Baghpat city. He had last visited the village about 25 years ago. He has an ancestral house in the village, but the gate is locked. Villagers said that no member of his family lives here anymore. Anurag studied at a village primary school DGP Anurag Dhankar’s family includes his wife Kalpana and son Abhishek. Abhishek lives in Canada. Anurag has two brothers. His younger brother Raviraj runs a toy shop in Baraut. His other brother Vivek worked with a private company after retiring from the Air Force. Anurag Dhankar’s friend Ramesh Kumar said, “We studied together up to Class 12. Anurag was a good volleyball player. After graduation, he moved to Delhi.”

stories.title: Conjunctivitis cases rise by up to 30% during monsoon:Gorakhpur doctor says eye redness and irritation are most common symptoms
stories.summary: The problem of eye infection is rapidly increasing during the rainy season in Gorakhpur. The number of patients with bacterial conjunctivitis has increased by 25 to 30% in the Eye OPD of the district hospital. Dr. Swapnil Tiwari said that patients suffering from problems like redness in the eyes, severe burning, itching, stinging, discharge of water or pus, and swelling in the eyelids are most frequently visiting the OPD. Most of these problems are being observed in school-going children. He said that this problem is due to rain. In such weather, there is humidity and bacteria spread rapidly, due to which cases of conjunctivitis increase. This infection, caused by bacteria, viruses, and allergies, can easily spread from one person to another. The doctor says that the eye is a delicate organ. In such a situation, even a little carelessness can cause a big problem. Special care has to be taken during the rainy season. More than 100 patients arrive in OPD every day Dr. Swapnil said that around 100 patients visit the eye OPD of the district hospital every day. Of these, 25 to 30 percent of patients have conjunctivitis. Among these, the majority are school-going children. Disease spreads through contact with dirty hands He said that during the rainy season, viruses and bacteria spread rapidly. In such a situation, infection spreads rapidly if contaminated water gets into the eyes or if dirty hands or clothes come into contact with the eyes. People go to family, school, office and crowded places and touch any fallen object with their hands. Then they touch their eyes with the same hand. Due to this, bacteria hidden in the hands reach the eyes and cause infection. Doctors say that many times this problem is also caused by water allergy. Such patients should take special care that rainwater does not reach their eyes. Symptoms of conjunctivitis The doctor said that patients with conjunctivitis show symptoms such as red eyes, watery eyes, eye pain, stinging and itching, burning, swelling, sticky eyelids, and difficulty in seeing. stories.title: Cattle smuggler arrested after encounter:Shot in leg as both sides exchange 4 rounds of fire; container loaded with cattle seized
stories.summary: On Monday morning in Varanasi, police had an encounter with cattle smugglers. Four rounds of firing took place between the police and the criminals. In retaliatory action, one smuggler was shot in the leg, after which the police cordoned him off and arrested him. This encounter took place in the Ramnagar police station area. The injured smuggler has been admitted to the hospital for treatment. A container full of cattle was also recovered from his possession. Police are investigating the accused's criminal history and his smuggling network in Varanasi. Taking cattle in container to Bihar ACP Kotwali Vijay Pratap Singh said that on Monday morning, information was received that cattle were being transported to Bihar in a container via Banaras. Based on the input, it was learned that the container was coming towards Ramnagar via Mohansarai-Dafi. As soon as the information was received, Ramnagar police station set up a blockade on the highway below the Vishwasundari Bridge and tried to stop the container. Seeing the police, the driver tried to flee and fired at the police team. In self-defense, the police returned fire, in which the smuggler was shot in the leg. The injured smuggler has been identified as Mohammad Ejaz, a resident of Bihar. He was immediately sent to the hospital, where he is undergoing treatment. Police seized the container and secured the cattle loaded in it. Initial investigation revealed that the accused has been involved in cattle smuggling multiple times before. ACP Vijay Pratap Singh said, The accused's criminal record is being investigated. Additionally, the search for other people associated with this animal smuggling gang is ongoing. Legal action is being taken in the matter. The forensic team was called to the spot to collect evidence, and a map of the crime scene is also being prepared.

stories.title: VIDEO | Woman constable slaps devotee at Banke Bihari Temple:Drags him out of the queue; mother pleads for his release
stories.summary: A woman constable allegedly thrashed a devotee inside Mathura's Banke Bihari Temple after being pushed during heavy crowding. As devotees jostled in the queue, the constable reportedly lost her temper, dragged the young man by his T-shirt and slapped him repeatedly. In just 25 seconds, she allegedly slapped him eight times. Mother pleads as officers continue assault Other police personnel present at the spot did not intervene. Instead, one officer allegedly twisted the youth's arm. Watching her son being beaten, his mother broke down in tears and kept pleading, "Please don't beat my son, he will die." Other devotees also tried to intervene, but the woman constable continued the assault. Devotee dragged outside after crowd protests After the beating, police personnel dragged the youth out of the VIP waiting area. The incident reportedly took place on Sunday, while its video surfaced around 9 am on Monday. The youth has not yet been identified. Dainik Bhaskar attempted to contact the temple administration and officials for their response, but they declined to comment. See pictures Crowd objects after scuffle near temple queue According to reports, the youth had arrived with his family for darshan on Sunday morning and was standing near the VIP railing at Gate No. 4. As the crowd swelled, pushing and shoving broke out, during which the woman constable was allegedly pushed. Enraged, she allegedly started beating the youth. Seeing her son being assaulted, his mother rushed towards him and repeatedly requested the police to let him go, but no one paid attention. As devotees objected to the assault and the crowd gathered, police personnel dragged the youth out of the VIP waiting area. Video captures repeated slaps and chaos The 56-second video shows the youth, wearing a red T-shirt, surrounded by three to four police personnel near the VIP railing. The woman constable is seen pushing him away from the railing, grabbing his T-shirt and repeatedly slapping him. The youth is seen trying to shield himself, but the constable continues the assault. His mother stands in front of the police personnel in an attempt to protect him, while the woman constable continues slapping him. Another policeman is seen holding the youth's arm before the group drags him away from the spot. When the crowd objected, they took the young man outside People objected to the young man being beaten by the female constable. Some people started making videos with their mobiles. Seeing the crowd growing, other policemen dragged the young man out of the VIP waiting area. Someone present at the scene shared a video of the incident on social media. After the video surfaced on Monday morning, people demanded action against the police officers involved in the assault. Attempts were made to speak with the temple administration and police officials regarding this matter, but they refused to comment. What is visible in the 56-second video The video viral on social media is approximately 56 seconds long. In it, a young man wearing a red T-shirt is surrounded by three-four police officers near the VIP railing. A female constable pushes him away from the railing and brings him out. The female constable has her hair open. She shouts loudly, grabs the young man's T-shirt, and slaps him. The young man tries to defend himself, but the female constable does not let go. Meanwhile, the young man's mother stands in front of the policemen and tries to save him, but the female constable keeps slapping him continuously. Meanwhile, a policeman standing nearby holds the young man's hand. After this, other policemen drag him out of there.

stories.title: Ram Mandir donation theft case:SC asks UP govt to form fresh SIT led by IPS officer, warns against politicisation
stories.summary: In the Ayodhya Ram Mandir donation theft case, the Supreme Court has ordered the formation of a fresh SIT. During the hearing at 3:30 pm on Monday, Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant said that a new SIT should be constituted. A senior IPS officer should lead the team so that the investigation can reach a conclusive stage. The CJI said the probe must be fair and conducted without any bias. The court directed that the investigation should be carried out properly. It asked Solicitor General (SG) Tushar Mehta to bring names from the Uttar Pradesh government for the SIT. The court will hear the matter next on 27 July. Advocate Devdutt Kamat and others appeared on behalf of the petitioners. Meanwhile, the already-constituted Special Investigation Team (SIT) submitted its status report in the Ayodhya Ram Mandir offering theft case to the Supreme Court late on Sunday night. According to media reports, the report has been filed in a sealed envelope. During the previous hearing on 13 July, the Supreme Court issued notices to the Uttar Pradesh government, the Centre, and the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust. The court directed the SIT to submit a status report and also ordered that the CCTV footage related to the case be preserved. Four separate petitions have been filed in the Supreme Court in connection with the alleged theft of temple offerings. Along with seeking a CBI investigation, the petitions also call for the formation of an expert committee to review the management of donations at the temple. Meanwhile, SP MP Awadhesh Prasad said, Today, it is regrettable that there has been theft of donations and offerings at the Ram Temple. This is a theft worth crores. BJP people want to save the real culprits. Meanwhile, an Ertiga car, a Bullet motorcycle, and cash have been recovered from Ramshankar Yadav alias 'Tinnu' and his nephew Manish, who are accused of theft of offerings. Land-related documents have also been found. Tinnu and Manish were taken into police remand. After completing 39 hours, both were sent back to jail on Sunday at 11 pm. Tinnu has been close to Champat Rai, the former general secretary of the Ram Temple Trust. He used to oversee the Mandir's donation boxes, while Manish was responsible for counting the offerings. Police had recovered ₹1 lakh from Tinnu's house and ₹2 lakh from Manish's house.

stories.title: Massive fire at four-storey govt building:18 fire engines deployed, smoke visible from 2 km away; deputy CM reaches spot
stories.summary: A fire broke out at around 9:53 am on Monday in a four-storey government building in Lucknow. Within minutes, massive flames engulfed the structure, while thick smoke was visible from nearly 2 km away. Fifteen fire engines reached the spot within 5–7 minutes, cordoned off the building, and brought the blaze under control after nearly an hour of firefighting. The incident occurred at Jawahar Bhawan in Hazratganj, one of the city's prime areas, just 2 km from the Uttar Pradesh Assembly. According to initial information, the Food and Civil Supplies Department's office and conference hall are located on the fourth floor, and the fire is believed to have started in the building's canteen. During the firefighting operation, part of the boundary wall on the rooftop collapsed. Fortunately, no one was underneath at the time, and no injuries were reported. Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak, District Magistrate Vishakh G., and Joint Commissioner of Police Bablu Kumar also reached the spot after being informed of the incident. See pictures

stories.title: 2 burnt alive in car fire, only skeletal remains found:Out-of-control car hits divider; CNG explosion triggers blaze
stories.summary: In Kanpur Dehat, UP, a car caught fire after a CNG blast. In no time, the car turned into a ball of fire. Flames rose 20 feet high. Two people in the car were burnt alive. The fire was so fierce that both occupants of the car did not get a chance to escape. They couldn't even get up from their seats. After the fire was brought under control, when inspected, the bodies were completely burnt. Only bones and charred flesh remained. The accident happened late Sunday night at 1 am. The car was coming from Delhi. It collided with a divider near Mungisapur, 20 kilometers from the district headquarters on the Kanpur-Etawah Highway. After the collision, there was a blast, and then the fire started. The deceased have been identified as Om Shukla (23) from Kanpur Nagar and driver Gurpreet (40). According to eyewitnesses, the car was traveling at a very high speed. It continued to burn for about 1 hour. High flames rising from the car were visible from 1.5 km away. Upon receiving the information, the police brought the fire under control with the help of the fire brigade. See pictures of the accident Went to Delhi to buy car-bike parts, accident on the way back According to the police, Om Shukla, a resident of Tatya Tope Nagar, Kanpur Nagar, runs a bike-car maintenance shop. On Sunday, he went to Delhi by car (DL 9C AA 2619) to buy bike-car parts. Driver Gurpreet was with him. After shopping in Delhi, they were returning home late at night. During this, the driver lost control of the car. The out-of-control car collided with the divider. Upon receiving information, Derapur police station and fire department teams reached the spot. The fire was brought under control after about an hour and a half of strenuous effort. After that, the car was searched. Two badly burnt bodies were recovered from inside. The police scraped the bodies, put them in black polythene, and sent them to the medical college for post-mortem. According to the police, the initial investigation suggests that high speed and the driver falling asleep were the cause of the accident. The Volkswagen Vento car could run on both CNG and petrol fuel. Accident due to high speed and momentary sleep According to the police, initial investigation suggests that high speed and the driver falling asleep for a moment seem to be the cause of the accident. It has come to light that the car was at high speed. After the driver lost control of the vehicle, the car directly collided with the divider. Immediately after the collision, the CNG tank exploded, engulfing the entire car in flames. The car was a Volkswagen Vento model, which ran on both CNG and petrol fuel. Station House Officer Dhirendra Singh said, The car has a Delhi registration number. Upon contacting the mobile number found during the registration check, it was revealed that the car had been sold to a person in Bihar quite some time ago. Subsequently, a burnt Aadhaar card was found in the car. Based on this, the deceased were identified. Efforts are being made to contact their relatives. Police scanning CCTV footage Police are investigating the exact causes of the accident. CCTV footage from the highway and surrounding areas is being scanned to ascertain the circumstances leading up to the accident.

stories.title: Rain lashes 10 UP cities, alert issued for 75 districts:Lucknow sees 10 hours of drizzle; Ganga swells in Kashi, water enters 40 temples
stories.summary: The spell of monsoon rain continues across Uttar Pradesh. Since Monday morning, the sky has remained overcast across the state, with rain being reported in 10 cities, including Lucknow, Kanpur, Gorakhpur and Ayodhya. Light rain, which began around 10.30 pm on Sunday in Lucknow and Kanpur, has continued into Monday morning. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rain alert for the entire state, warning of heavy rainfall in 69 cities. Meanwhile, continuous rainfall in the hills has caused river levels in Uttar Pradesh to rise rapidly. In Varanasi and Prayagraj, the steps of several ghats have gone underwater. In Kashi, floodwater has entered around 40 small temples, including the Ratneshwar Mahadev Temple, stretching from Dashashwamedh Ghat to Panchganga Ghat. In Sant Kabir Nagar, the 300-year-old Baba Baijunath Temple collapsed due to heavy rain. Riverbank erosion has begun along the Saryu River in Ballia and the Sharda River in Lakhimpur. Around 100 villages are facing the threat of flooding, while two houses have already been washed away by the river. Over the past 24 hours, seven people have died across the state due to rain-related incidents and lightning strikes. In Muzaffarnagar, five members of a family were killed after a mud house collapsed and buried them under the debris. In Ballia and Chandauli, one farmer each died after being struck by lightning while transplanting paddy in the fields. Heavy rain likely for next 5–6 days Earlier on Sunday, rainfall was recorded in 30 cities across the state. Hamirpur received the highest rainfall at 54 mm, followed by Shravasti (40.5 mm), Sultanpur (37.3 mm), Maharajganj (36.2 mm), and Ghazipur (35.7 mm). The IMD has forecast heavy rainfall across Uttar Pradesh over the next five to six days and has advised people living in low-lying areas and along riverbanks to remain alert. Lucknow-based meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said, The monsoon has become active again over Uttar Pradesh. A low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal and a cloud system moving towards Jharkhand have caused the monsoon winds to shift towards the state. As a result, rainfall activity has intensified. Similar weather conditions are expected to continue until 24 July, with some places in the southern parts of the state likely to receive heavy rainfall. Weather-related pictures

stories.title: Woman accused in husband's snakebite murder seeks boyfriend in jail:Breaks down in Meerut jail; to be lodged with ‘Blue Drum’ accused Muskan after 10 days
stories.summary: The woman accused of orchestrating the murder of her school-owner husband by allegedly getting him bitten by a snake is reportedly struggling to adjust to life in Meerut District Jail. According to jail officials, Damini, who was lodged in prison on July 18, has repeatedly requested prison authorities to arrange a meeting with her alleged boyfriend Tushar, saying, "He is everything to me." The request was denied as it does not comply with jail regulations. Officials say Damini has remained withdrawn, frequently crying and unable to sleep since entering prison. Let's explain in detail how Damini and Tushar spent their first night in jail on Saturday Meeting with boyfriend not allowed under jail rules Senior Jail Superintendent Dr. Viresh Raj Sharma said Damini repeatedly asked prison staff to allow her to meet Tushar. However, jail rules permit meetings only between blood relatives or legally married spouses. Since Damini and Tushar share neither relationship, the request was declined. Interestingly, officials said Tushar himself did not request a meeting with Damini. The other two accused in the case—Sonu and Uday, who allegedly helped arrange the snake used in the crime—are also lodged in the jail. Officials described their behaviour as normal. So far, none of the four accused have reportedly received visitors from their families or acquaintances. Sleepless night and Emotional distress According to jail authorities, Damini spent her first night in prison tossing and turning. She initially refused dinner and reportedly ate only one roti after repeated persuasion by jail staff. Other women inmates interacted among themselves, but Damini remained isolated throughout the evening. She was seen standing silently for long periods, sitting with her head in her hands, and pacing inside the barrack. Women inmates later informed jail staff that Damini cried repeatedly during the night, mentioning Tushar's name and occasionally recalling her son. Officials said she did not speak much beyond that. Currently kept in separate barrack for new prisoners Dr. Sharma said Damini, Tushar, Sonu and Uday were admitted to jail on July 18 after being sent to judicial custody in connection with the alleged murder of school operator Atul, who investigators say was killed through a planned snake bite. As newly admitted prisoners, all four will remain in the new inmates' barracks for 10 days. Will be shifted to older barrack after 10 days Under prison rules, Damini will be transferred to the barracks for long-term inmates after completing the mandatory observation period. The same women's barrack currently houses: Officials clarified that Damini has not yet met or spoken with either Muskan or Ravita. Similarly, Tushar will later be shifted to the men's barracks where Sahil, Muskan's alleged boyfriend, and Amardeep, Ravita's alleged boyfriend, are currently lodged. Health check found all four accused fit Before being admitted to prison, Damini, Tushar, Sonu and Uday underwent medical examinations. According to jail authorities: Officials, however, noted that she remains emotionally withdrawn and is avoiding interaction with others. Three women accused of killing their husbands are currently lodged in Meerut Jail 1. Muskan Rastogi In March 2025, Muskan allegedly murdered her Merchant Navy officer husband Saurabh Rajput with the help of her alleged boyfriend Sahil. According to investigators, Saurabh was first drugged before being stabbed to death. His body was allegedly dismembered and sealed inside a blue plastic drum using cement and sand. Both Muskan and Sahil are currently in judicial custody. 2. Ravita In April 2025, Ravita and her alleged boyfriend Amardeep were accused of killing her husband Amit. Police allege Amit was strangled while asleep, after which a snake was placed on the bed to make the death appear accidental. The post-mortem examination reportedly ruled out snake bite as the cause of death, leading investigators to treat it as a murder. 3. Komal In April 2026, Komal and her alleged boyfriend Gulshan were arrested for the murder of her husband Nain Singh, a Border Security Force (BSF) jawan. According to police, the couple allegedly arranged a contract killing by pledging jewellery to finance the payment to the hired assailants. Five people were arrested in the case. Investigation continues The investigation into Damini's case is ongoing. Police have accused her and the other co-accused of conspiring to murder her husband by arranging a snake bite, while all the accused remain in judicial custody pending further legal proceedings.

stories.title: How to avoid property fraud while buying land or house:Find out if the land is disputed, mortgaged, or under litigation
stories.summary: Buying property without verifying ownership or legal records can lead to costly fraud, including fake registrations, disputed land, or the same plot being sold to multiple buyers. You can now check the complete legal status of any land or house online in just five minutes, helping you verify ownership, avoid scams, and make a safe property purchase. Check these documents before registration Before buying land or a flat, thoroughly check all its necessary documents. First, look at the original sale deed (Bainama), which shows when and from whom the current owner bought this property. After that, definitely check the holding tax receipt. This shows whether the property tax is being paid correctly and in whose name the record is. Just having a registration is not enough. Also, definitely check the Kharij-Dakhil (Mutation). This will show whether the land or house is registered in the name of the current owner in government records or not. After the registration, get the mutation done within 90 days. Until the old owner's name is removed from the land record (khatoni) and your name is registered, the land is not considered to be in your name in government records. Often, fraudsters take advantage of this loophole and sell the same land to someone else. Finally, always check the encumbrance certificate. This shows whether there is any loan, outstanding dues, or legal dispute on the property. Only if all these documents are found to be correct, should you decide to buy the property. How to identify fake registration Before buying a property, make sure to check whether its registry is genuine or fake. For this, follow some easy steps. First, visit igrsup.gov.in. Here, go to the 'Search Property' option and enter the registry number and year of registration. This will reveal whether the registry is recorded in government records or not. If the land has been bought and sold multiple times before, compare all its old registries. If there's a missing link or the records don't match, conduct a thorough investigation before finalizing the deal. Also, verify the witnesses mentioned in the registry. Check with local people or at the local level whether the individuals who signed as witnesses actually exist. Fake registries often include fake witnesses. Give a public notice before buying a large property If you are buying expensive land, a house, or a large plot, then through your lawyer, definitely publish a public notice in one Hindi and one English newspaper. In it, write that you are going to buy this property and if any person, bank, or institution has any claim or objection on it, they should contact with proof within 15 days. This makes it easier to prove in court later, if any dispute arises, that you bought the property after thorough investigation. This strengthens the buyer's legal position. Is there a loan or court case on the land? Find out this way Often, fraudsters sell land on which a heavy loan has been taken from a bank or a lawsuit for ownership is ongoing in court. There are two ways to check this: First: Go to the upbhulekh.gov.in portal and get the land's Khasra-Khatauni (land record). In the Khasra-Khatauni, look at the 'Detail/Comment' column. If the land is mortgaged with a bank or there is a court stay order on it, this information is recorded here. Second: Get an 'Index Search' done for that land using its Gata number (plot number) at the Sub-Registrar's office. This work can also be done through a lawyer or a deed writer. This will reveal how many registrations have been done on the land previously, whether there is a bank loan, or if any legal dispute is ongoing. Avoid these 9 mistakes when buying property

stories.title: Why Governor said Additional Chief Secretary 'keeps moving files around':8 major UP projects stalled, MLAs anxious ahead of Assembly polls
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Governor Anandiben Patel has held Additional Chief Secretary (Higher Education) M.P. Agarwal responsible for the delay in providing scooters to eligible girl students. Expressing her displeasure, she remarked, ‘They keep moving this file from one office to another.’ Following the Governor's sharp criticism, Dainik Bhaskar examined the progress of several flagship projects under the Yogi Adityanath government. The investigation found that some schemes have either failed to take off or remain stuck due to bureaucratic delays, procedural bottlenecks and internal disputes. With Assembly elections approaching, MLAs are likely to face questions from voters over the lack of progress. Here are eight major projects that remain delayed. 1. Rani Lakshmi Bai Scooty Yojana One year spent framing rules, which still exclude many rural students Announcement: The BJP had promised to provide scooters to meritorious girl students in its 2022 election manifesto. The state allocated ₹400 crore for the scheme in the 2025–26 Budget. Bureaucratic hurdle: Officials took nearly a year to frame the scheme's rules. The final eligibility criteria require students to score at least 90%, a condition that has drawn criticism. Impact: Governor Anandiben Patel objected to the rule, saying it would mainly benefit girls in urban areas studying in private schools with access to tuition. She said girls from rural areas, many of whom walk 10–12 km to attend school, would largely be excluded from the scheme. 2. Bus Stand Redevelopment (PPP Mode) Tender process delayed by dispute between senior officials Project: Forty-nine bus stands across Uttar Pradesh are to be modernised under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model. Bureaucratic hurdle: Under government rules, tenders should be opened the day after submission. However, an ongoing dispute between Additional Chief Secretary Archana Agarwal and Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC) Managing Director P.N. Singh has stalled the process. First-phase tenders have remained pending for a month, while second-phase tenders have been delayed by 11 days. Impact: Even after intervention by Transport Minister Dayashankar Singh, the files did not move forward. With elections nearing, MLAs want construction work to begin quickly in their constituencies. Skill Development Minister Kapil Dev Agarwal has also written to the government urging action. 3. Smartphone and Tablet Distribution Scheme Target of two crore beneficiaries in five years; only 60 lakh devices distributed in four years Promise: The government planned to distribute smartphones and tablets to two crore students over five years. The 2025–26 Budget earmarked ₹2,374 crore to provide devices to 40 lakh students. Bureaucratic hurdle: Delays in framing guidelines, issuing tenders and completing procurement slowed implementation. In four years, only 60 lakh devices have been distributed. The nodal agency, UPDESCO, and the Industrial Development Department are still engaged in the tendering and price negotiation process. Impact: Ahead of the Assembly elections, MLAs want devices distributed through them to students aged over 18, hoping the programme reaches beneficiaries before polling. However, large-scale procurement and supply are expected to take more time. 4. Outsourced Services Corporation Corporation established, but no recruitment after one year Announcement: Following the 2025 Budget, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced that the minimum honorarium for outsourced employees would be increased to ₹16,000 per month and that an Outsourced Services Corporation would be created to manage recruitment. In September 2025, IAS officer Amrita Soni was appointed Managing Director of the corporation. Bureaucratic hurdle: Nearly a year after its formation, not a single recruitment has been initiated through the corporation. Impact: There is still no clarity on revised salaries, allowances, provident fund deductions or gratuity benefits. More than three lakh outsourced employees continue to wait for the promised increase in their honorarium. Four more major projects progressing slowly 1. UP Startup mission In July 2024, Information Technology Minister Sunil Sharma directed officials to launch the UP Startup Mission. However, the proposal remained stuck in bureaucratic processes for nearly two years before recently receiving Cabinet approval. There is still no timeline for its launch. Meanwhile, the SWAN-3 project, intended to provide high-speed digital connectivity to blocks and gram panchayats, has also seen little progress under the Higher Education Department led by ACS Alok Kumar. 2. Family ID Scheme The government had promised employment opportunities for at least one member of every family under the 'Ek parivar, Ek pehchan' initiative. However, due to administrative delays, the scheme has yet to move beyond the planning stage and remains largely on paper. 3. Labour Adda Scheme The government announced in the 2025 Budget that Labour Addas would be established for construction workers in all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh. More than a year later, the scheme has been implemented only in six major cities, including Lucknow, Noida and Ghaziabad. The remaining 69 districts are yet to see any progress. 4. Groundbreaking ceremony Following the first Ground Breaking Ceremony in February 2024, investors have been waiting for the second edition. When asked about the delay in projects handled by Invest UP and the Industrial Development Department, ACS Alok Kumar said the department was fully prepared and that the programme would be held once the Chief Minister finalised a suitable date.

stories.title: Brij Bhushan's changed tone sparks speculation:Praises Akhilesh as ‘Krishna’s descendant’, swipe at BJP fuels talks over his discontent
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader and six-time former MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh has once again sparked political debate with a series of statements that appear to contradict his party's official position. His recent remarks rejecting Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's claim about Hanumangarhi and describing Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav as a "religious person" and a "descendant of Lord Krishna" have fueled speculation over whether he is signalling political dissent or preparing for a new political role. The statements come amid a pattern of public positions over the past two years in which Brij Bhushan has alternately praised Prime Minister Narendra Modi, questioned Yogi Adityanath's leadership, criticised the Ram Mandir Trust, and made comments at odds with the BJP's broader political messaging. The Hanumangarhi row On July 10, while addressing a gathering at Sohawal in Ayodhya, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath claimed: "During the Samajwadi Party government, namaz was offered on the steps of Hanumangarhi temple and Roza Iftar was organised there. If opposition parties are truly secular, can they organise a Hanuman Chalisa recital inside a Jama Masjid?" Seven days later, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh publicly contradicted the Chief Minister. He said: "Namaz was never offered at Hanumangarhi. That claim is completely false. The Hanumangarhi temple was constructed by a Muslim, and even today a stone bearing his name is installed there." The remark immediately drew attention because it directly challenged the Chief Minister's version of events. A pattern of contradictory statements Political observers note that this is not the first time Brij Bhushan has departed from the BJP's official narrative. Over the past two years, he has: These repeated interventions have led to speculation that the veteran leader may be attempting to redefine his political position. Shared political roots with Yogi Adityanath Despite the recent differences, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh and Yogi Adityanath share a long political association. Both were disciples of Mahant Avaidyanath, the former head of the Gorakhnath Math. A frequently recalled incident from Parliament involved Yogi Adityanath becoming emotional during a speech, when Brij Bhushan, seated beside him, handed him a handkerchief. Even so, their public statements in recent years have often suggested growing political distance. Political experts see long-term strategy Senior journalist Anand Rai believes politicians frame public statements around future political objectives. According to him, Brij Bhushan has always respected Mahant Avaidyanath, and while no personal hostility between him and Yogi Adityanath has openly emerged, his recent remarks indicate political calculations that may relate to future ambitions. 'His political stature extends beyond BJP' Senior Ayodhya-based journalist Indrabhushan Pandey argues that Brij Bhushan's political identity is larger than his party affiliation. He points out that despite the BJP's stated opposition to dynastic politics, the party fielded both Brij Bhushan's wife and son in elections, reflecting his political influence. Pandey also maintains that Brij Bhushan's comments on Hanumangarhi are consistent with historical records. According to him, historical gazetteers mention that Nawab Shuja-ud-Daula played a role in the construction of Hanumangarhi, and there is no historical evidence of namaz or Roza Iftar being organised on the temple steps. He also noted that Brij Bhushan was one of the prominent leaders of the Ram Temple movement and felt slighted after not receiving an invitation to the consecration ceremony. Pandey further said that some religious scholars, including all four Shankaracharyas, consider the temple religiously incomplete because its shikhara (spire) and religious flag have not yet been installed. Openly speaking on reservation and upper-caste politics While the BJP has taken a cautious approach on issues such as caste census and reservation, Brij Bhushan has frequently voiced support for upper-caste concerns. Senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh says Brij Bhushan has never openly endorsed reservation in its present form and believes those who have already benefited should not repeatedly receive reservation benefits. According to Singh, Brij Bhushan has consistently cultivated upper-caste politics because of the demographic composition of his constituency. At the same time, Singh notes that the former MP also enjoys support across caste and religious groups, including among Muslims. Signals of a new political alignment? Following the controversy involving allegations by women wrestlers, Brij Bhushan's own political standing within the BJP appears to have weakened, although his political family remains influential, with one son serving as an MLA and another as an MP. Suresh Bahadur Singh believes Brij Bhushan still feels politically sidelined and has publicly expressed his desire to return to Parliament—whether on a BJP ticket or as an Independent. According to him, Brij Bhushan's recent statements may indicate efforts to rebuild his political relevance and negotiate from a stronger position. Could the Samajwadi Party become an option again? This would not be the first time Brij Bhushan has switched political camps. After being expelled from the BJP in 2008, he joined the Samajwadi Party under Mulayam Singh Yadav and won the 2009 Lok Sabha election on an SP ticket. Ironically, Mulayam Singh had earlier ordered his arrest during the Ram Temple movement. Political observers believe Brij Bhushan's recent praise of Akhilesh Yadav may be a form of "pressure politics"—signalling to the BJP leadership that he has political alternatives. Anand Rai says Brij Bhushan's earlier conflict with the SP stemmed largely from his rivalry with Gonda politician Vinod Singh alias Pandit Singh, whom Mulayam Singh reportedly favoured. Why is Brij Bhushan considered upset? Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh has been elected to the Lok Sabha six times—in 1991, 1999, 2004, 2009, 2014 and 2019—from Kaiserganj, Gonda and Balrampur. He also secured parliamentary victories for his wife in 1996 and his son in 2024. Despite his electoral influence, he has never been given a major ministerial or organisational role in either the state or central leadership, something political observers say he believes he deserved. After the wrestlers' protest, he was forced to step down from the Wrestling Federation, and the BJP denied him a ticket in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. Why BJP cannot ignore him Political analysts believe Brij Bhushan continues to wield considerable influence in eastern Uttar Pradesh. He is considered influential across nearly 20 Assembly constituencies in districts such as Gonda, Basti, Bahraich and Balrampur, while his reach among Rajput voters extends to nearly 50 Assembly seats in Purvanchal. Earlier this year, he demonstrated his organisational strength through the 'Rashtrakatha' event at Nandini College in Gonda. He also remains a recognised face among Rajput communities in neighbouring Bihar, where he campaigned during Assembly elections. Potential electoral impact Analysts say Brij Bhushan may not be capable of independently delivering victories across these constituencies, but his dissatisfaction could influence Rajput voting patterns enough to hurt the BJP in closely contested seats. Political commentators draw parallels with Kalyan Singh's exit from the BJP in 2002, when he won only a handful of seats himself but was widely credited with contributing to the defeat of numerous BJP candidates. A similar impact was seen when Shivpal Yadav's rebellion affected the Samajwadi Party's prospects in the 2017 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. With his increasingly independent public stance, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh's political moves are likely to remain under close watch as Uttar Pradesh's political landscape evolves.

stories.title: Woman sub-inspector slaps complainant 5 times:Says ‘I am fed up, I will teach you a lesson today’; DCP suspends her
stories.summary: A woman sub-inspector in Varanasi allegedly slapped a complainant repeatedly instead of listening to her grievance. The officer told the woman, “I am fed up with your daily complaints. Today, I will treat you.” Roshni Singh, posted at Chaubeypur police station, slapped the woman five times within eight seconds. People present at the station intervened and brought the situation under control. The incident took place on Thursday evening around 5 pm, and its video surfaced on Friday. After the incident of a woman complainant being publicly assaulted at the police station sparked outrage, DCP Pramod Kumar suspended Sub-Inspector Roshni Singh and ordered a departmental inquiry against her. Woman had reached police station over land dispute The complainant, Dalit woman Geeta Devi, is a resident of Paranapur in Chaubeypur. Several years ago, she received residential land from the village community land through a government lease. Her family lives on one part of the land, while the remaining portion was vacant. Geeta Devi alleged that her neighbours were trying to occupy the vacant portion of the land. She had filed a complaint at Chaubeypur police station on June 15, accusing Poonam Devi and others of attempting to take possession of her land. Sub-inspector got angry after hearing woman's reply Police had called both parties to Chaubeypur police station on July 16. During the discussion, the woman sub-inspector asked Geeta Devi to call her husband. Geeta replied that her husband was away at work and said, “We are poor people. We earn and eat every day.” As soon as Geeta raised her voice, Sub-Inspector Roshni Singh allegedly lost her temper and started slapping her. Geeta alleged that the officer first assaulted her in front of everyone at the police station. She further claimed that she was later locked inside a room and beaten severely. 2023 batch officer, first posting at Chaubeypur police station Sub-Inspector Roshni Singh is originally from Bihar. She belongs to the 2023 batch and received her first posting at Chaubeypur police station under the Varanasi Commissionerate after being selected for the police service. She is currently serving at the same police station as part of her first posting. Video raises questions over police conduct on social media After the video surfaced, people on social media questioned police behaviour. One user wrote, “Five slaps in eight seconds... Is this part of training? If decisions are taken this way, then what is the need for courts?” ACP Sarnath Vinay Dwivedi said ACP Sarnath Vinay Dwivedi said, “The video has been taken into cognisance. Based on the initial investigation, DCP has suspended Sub-Inspector Roshni Singh. The matter is being investigated. Further action will be taken based on the facts that emerge.”

stories.title: Rampur SP removed, Somendra Meena transferred:Azam Khan’s wife had sent police personnel away from Jauhar University a day earlier
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government transferred five IPS officers on Friday evening, including the SPs of Rampur and Lalitpur. Rampur SP Somendra Meena has been transferred to Agra Intelligence, while 2015-batch promoted IPS officer Anil Kumar Singh has been appointed as the new Rampur SP. Anil Kumar Singh was earlier posted at the Security Headquarters. The transfer comes two days after the Rampur district administration ordered the demolition of Azam Khan’s Mohammad Ali Jauhar University. On Thursday, Azam Khan’s wife Tanzin Fatima reached the university and allegedly confronted police personnel present there. She objected to their presence and sent them away from the university premises, leading to embarrassment for the police department. Lalitpur SP Mohammad Mushtaq shifted to Lucknow The government has also removed Lalitpur SP Mohammad Mushtaq and appointed him as DCP in the Lucknow Police Commissionerate. Mushtaq had served as Lalitpur SP for nearly three years. See the transfer list... Anil Kumar Singh appointed Rampur SP Anil Kumar Singh became an IPS officer in 2022 after being promoted from the Provincial Police Service (PPS). After becoming an IPS officer, he served at the Recruitment Board and as Commandant of the 28th Battalion PAC in Etawah. He was posted at the Security Headquarters from October 10, 2025. Somendra Meena removed after three-and-a-half months Somendra Meena was appointed as Rampur SP on March 30 and was removed after around three-and-a-half months. The 2017-batch IPS officer had earlier served as SP of Maharajganj. Meena is a native of Karauli district in Rajasthan. Sanjeev Kumar Bajpai becomes Lalitpur SP Sanjeev Kumar Bajpai has been appointed as the new Lalitpur SP in place of Mohammad Mushtaq. Bajpai is a 2018-batch promoted IPS officer and was earlier posted as Commandant of the 43rd Battalion PAC in Etah. Other IPS transfers Mohammad Mushtaq, a 2016-batch IPS officer originally from Chhapra district of Bihar, had earlier served as SP GRP in Agra, besides postings in Mathura, Varanasi and Jhansi. Lucknow Police Commissionerate DCP Gopal Krishna Chaudhary has been transferred and appointed as Commandant of the 32nd Battalion PAC.

In this sequence, the redeveloped station of Aishbagh Junction of North Eastern Railway, Lucknow Division will also be inaugurated. Prime Minister to join via video conferencing According to railway officials, Prime Minister Narendra Modi will today virtually inaugurate the stations developed under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme, which have been prepared in various states of the country. Aishbagh Junction is also among these major stations, where modern and better facilities have been made available to passengers. Public representatives will be present Local public representatives, railway officials, dignitaries and a large number of local people will be present at the program organized at Aishbagh Junction. During the inauguration program, information about the station's redevelopment works will also be shared.

stories.title: Axes in hand, SP workers protest in Lucknow:Demonstrate over Ram Mandir offering theft, police bus them to Eco Garden
stories.summary: SP workers protested at Hazratganj intersection in Lucknow on Friday at 12:05 PM. Their protest was against the Ayodhya Ram Temple offering theft case. The protesting SP members arrived dressed as Brahmins. They carried an axe (farsa) and a donation box made of thermocol. During the protest, workers raised slogans against the government, alleging that attempts were being made to suppress the matter. There was a lot of pushing and shoving and arguments between the police and the protesters. The police put everyone on buses and sent them to Eco Garden. 'Theft in Ram Temple is shameful' SP workers protesting loudly chanted 'Send donation thieves to jail'. Uday Pratap, who was protesting, said that it is extremely shameful that theft is happening in the Ram Temple. When this government cannot stop theft in God's house, what can be expected elsewhere? Even invaders did not loot temples in the way looting is happening under the BJP government. This shows that these people are only filling their own banks in the name of Ram. 'Big faces have not been exposed' Yuvraj, who participated in the protest, said, "We, the SP members, are protecting the Constitution, culture, and Sanatan all three. Regarding the theft that occurred at the Ram Temple, so far only small pawns are being acted upon. The big faces behind this have not been exposed. By taking action against minor employees, this entire matter is being put on the back burner." "Our leader Akhilesh Yadav is continuously raising awareness among the general public regarding this issue. We appeal to all devotees of Ram to be wary of those who loot in the name of Ram. The Ram Temple is the centre of faith for crores of Sanatanis. The way our faith is being toyed with is extremely shameful."

Two accused who shot cops killed in Firozabad encounter:Jumped off train; 300 personnel surrounded fields for 2 hours
stories.summary: Two SOG constables were shot and injured in an encounter with two wanted criminals at Shikohabad railway station in Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad district on Friday morning. The accused later fled towards Nagla village but were killed in a police encounter during a massive combing operation. The encounter took place around 11:45 am when the Etawah Special Operations Group (SOG) surrounded the suspects at the railway station. According to police, the accused opened fire while trying to escape. Constables David Chauhan and Pushpendra suffered bullet injuries, one in the abdomen and the other in the shoulder. Both were rushed to hospital for treatment. Police said the two criminals managed to flee after the initial exchange of fire. Officers chased them for nearly 1 km before they hid inside Nagla village. The village was then cordoned off from all sides, and an extensive search operation was launched. During the combing operation, both accused were shot dead in a fresh encounter. Police had received intelligence that the two criminals were travelling on the Sambalpur Express from Ghaziabad to Jharkhand. Acting on the tip-off, the Etawah SOG team laid a trap at Shikohabad railway station. As the train arrived, the suspects got down and tried to run, triggering the encounter. Soon after the incident, DIG, Etawah SSP Brajesh Srivastava and ASP Abhay Nath Tripathi rushed to the spot with additional police personnel. Around 300 police personnel carried out an intensive search operation across the area.

stories.title: 72 wrestlers to get training at Sigra SAI NCOE:Wrestlers from UP, Haryana, Punjab, Maharashtra and Karnataka arrive; Dronacharya awardee leads selection
stories.summary: Selection trials for wrestling training are underway at the NCOE Centre, started by SAI in Varanasi. More than 150 wrestlers are showcasing their skills in this. For this center, 36 male and 36 female wrestlers will be selected in different categories. A representative from TIDEC Delhi has been nominated to conduct these selection trials, under whose supervision they are currently underway. Two Dronacharya awardees, Mahasingh Rawat and Mahavir Prasad, and Chief Coach Sahil Sharma from Lucknow SAI are present. See three pictures Selection will be for 36-36 seats Regarding the selection, Deputy Director Sigra SAI NCOE Shubhanshu Dwivedi informed - Currently, trials for the wrestling discipline are being held by SAI for this NCEO centre. This selection is for the residential scheme. We have 36-36 seats in the men's and women's categories. The entire vacancy will be filled. In the junior category, we will also keep two to three seats vacant in case any wrestler is unable to join, as these are admission seasons. In the senior category, there will only be one or two on the waitlist. The final list will be released this evening Shubhanshu Dwivedi informed - We will finalise a list of 60 to 70. Out of which, 36-36 wrestlers will be taken for the final selection trial. To ensure the integrity of this entire process, Sahil Sharma, who has been a Dronacharya awardee and coach to Sakshi and Vinesh Phogat, is conducting the trials. The final list will be released by the evening of July 17.

stories.title: CM likely to visit in Gorakhpur on July 22:6-lane flyover inauguration may take place, BJP booth conference on agenda
stories.summary: CM Yogi will reach Gorakhpur on July 22. On the same day, he will inaugurate the city's first six-lane flyover. On July 22 itself, BJP is going to organize booth conferences simultaneously in all assembly constituencies of the state. The booth conference for Gorakhpur Urban and Gorakhpur Rural assembly constituencies will be held at Yogiraj Baba Gambhirnath Auditorium. The Chief Minister will also participate here. During this visit, the Chief Minister may also attend the Shri Ram Katha starting from July 23 at Gorakhnath Temple. The Chief Minister's program has not been officially confirmed yet, but the administration has started preparations. The Chief Minister may arrive in Gorakhpur on the morning of the 22nd. First, he will participate in the BJP's booth conference organized at Yogiraj Baba Gambhirnath Auditorium. 829 booth presidents from Gorakhpur Urban and Gorakhpur Rural assembly constituencies will participate in this conference. MP Ravi Kishan, Gorakhpur Rural MLA Vipin Singh, Mayor Dr. Manglesh Srivastava, and Metropolitan President Ramesh Gupta will also participate in this. The Metropolitan Committee has started preparing for this event. Flyover built at a cost of 429 crores The Chief Minister will inaugurate the six-lane cum four-lane flyover, which has been constructed at a cost of 429 crore rupees. The six-lane flyover starts from the petrol pump near Indira Nagar on the Padleganj-Nausad road and ends approximately 2.2 kilometers ahead of the Transportnagar police outpost. A roundabout is also being built on the Deoria bypass. From here, a four-lane bridge is being lowered onto the Deoria bypass. Its length is approximately 400 meters. If both bridges are combined, the total length is more than 2600 meters. With the construction of this bridge, travel on the Lucknow route will become even easier. The problem of traffic jams at Deoria Bypass, Nahar Road Tiraaha, Rustampur Chauraha, Falamandi Chauraha, and Transportnagar Chauraha will be resolved. People will be able to start from Padleganj and go directly to Transportnagar. Those who need to go towards Deoria Bypass can descend onto that road directly from above.

The accused stopped the woman and her friend late on Thursday night, asked her to marry him, and opened fire when she said no. The woman was seriously injured and is undergoing treatment at a hospital. As the accused fled, he allegedly shouted that if she would not marry him, he would not let her marry anyone else. Police have registered a case and launched a search for the accused. The incident is being investigated further. 2 pictures from after the incident Now, understand the entire matter in a sequential manner Despite being married, he was pressuring her for marriage Ayesha said - The accused Ballu lives near the Gaddha Wali Masjid. He is married. He married his maternal uncle's daughter. Despite this, he was pressuring Shaheen for marriage. He had been harassing her for a long time. My friend often told me about this. She used to ask for ways to get rid of him. She didn't go to the police for fear of defamation. We didn't know it would come to this. Brother said - Sister came home 5 days ago The brother said - We are three siblings. The eldest sister, who was shot, works at a beauty parlor in Shyamnagar. She had come home 5 days ago. The police arrived at 1 AM, and that's when we learned about the incident. Girl undergoing treatment, investigation ongoing After receiving information about the incident, the police from Brahmapuri and Lisari Gate police stations, along with the SP City, reached the spot. SP City Vinayak Gopal Bhosle said that information about firing was received. So far, the investigation and questioning suggest a case of unrequited love. The girl is undergoing treatment. The police are investigating based on all facts and evidence.

stories.title: 'Oh Allah, I won't slaughter cows anymore':Bareilly cattle smuggling suspect screams after police firing; 40 kg meat found at home
stories.summary: In Bareilly, a cow smuggler was arrested in an encounter around 10 PM on Thursday night. The accused was shot in the leg during the encounter, after which he was arrested. After being injured, the accused cried out, "Oh Allah... I made a mistake, I will never slaughter cows again." Earlier on Thursday afternoon, police raided the accused's house and recovered about 40 kg of beef, four legs of cattle, and animal slaughtering tools. During the operation, 3 people, including the main accused, had fled. During the late-night search, the accused fired at the police team, after which he was injured in retaliatory action. This encounter took place in the Izzatnagar police station area. Now read the full case in detail Cow's leg found in house during raid According to the police, on Thursday around 12 noon, information was received that cow slaughter was being carried out at the house of Akiluddin alias Gattu in Mahlau village. As soon as the information was received, Izzatnagar police station reached the spot and raided. Seeing the police, the accused present there started fleeing. During the operation, the police arrested Mohammad Khan from the spot, while the main accused Akiluddin, his accomplice Alam, and Haseena fled. During the search, the police found about 40 kg of beef, four legs of cattle, and tools used for slaughtering animals. Police interrogation revealed that Akiluddin is the main accused of this entire gang. He used to slaughter cows. After this, the police registered a case against him and other accused and started searching for them. Seeing himself surrounded, the accused fired at the police Late at night, the police were raiding in search of Akiluddin based on the information provided by Mohammad Khan. During this, seeing himself surrounded, the accused tried to escape. The police asked him to surrender, but he fired at the police team. Police retaliated, and Aqiluddin was shot in the leg. He was arrested after being injured. According to the police, during the arrest, an illegal .315 bore pistol, one spent cartridge, and one live cartridge were recovered from the possession of the accused. Search for other absconding accused continues SP City Manush Parik stated - The main accused, Aqiluddin, has been arrested after an encounter. He has been sent to the district hospital for treatment. Police teams are continuously raiding to arrest other absconding accused involved in the case. All the accused will be arrested soon.
